data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ghusna’, meaning ‘blossom’ or ‘bloom’. It symbolizes new life, growth, and beauty. In Islamic traditions, it is a reminder of the spiritual growth and development that comes from following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Ghusn carries the meaning “Blossom, bloom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghusn usually hope their child will grow to embody blossom, bloom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
